predictions.description: Whether to mark as predictions (e.g. for manual correction)

ocrd-split-pages.description: Split a page into multiple segments based on gutter detection

paddleocr_model.description: PaddleOCR model name for text detection.

device.description: Device to run the OCR model on. e.g. 'cpu', 'gpu', 'gpu:0'.

proj_func.description: Projection function to use for gutter detection.

number_breakpoints.description: Number of breakpoints (splits) to detect using Dynamic Programming.

close_threshold.description: Threshold to consider a value close to 'almost gutter'.

fallback_to_center.description: If no minima detected, whether to fallback to a single center split (two pages)

segment_size.description: Minimum width in pixels for a segment to be valid. Segments smaller than this are skipped. Used for cases with text in the gutter.
